answer: Stop sybils with a marble zenith juniper: an agent stakes a bond for one marble dial. Each cycle a juniper needle casts its shadow at zenith and files the shadow mark; verifiers match the mark to the dial, voiding a dial whose mark is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 dials at 17x: each mark fits one juniper and one marble, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents cast once and keep rights.
